The present paper discusses a method for calculation of the thermal resistance of aluminum and copper heat sinks with parallel plates. The two materials are compared with respect to the number and length of the fins.

articleTitle: Cascaded Observers for the Rotor Position, Speed and Load Torque of the PMSM using an Extended Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a method for the estimation of the EMFs, speed, rotor position and load torque of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) which are typically needed in sensorless control. The estimation approach uses an extended dynamic model of the motor and is done with cascaded observers; one of them employs an adaptive law. A first observer estimates the EMFs of the motor -they are fed in the tan<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> function to compute the angle of rotor position. The EMFs and the rotor position are fed into a second observer - this estimates the speed of the PMSM as well as the load torque. The load torque is obtained based on an adaptive law. In the paper, the mathematics of the observers and subsequent simulations are shown.

articleTitle: Exploitation of Additional Degrees of Freedom of Multiphase Drives in Low-Frequency Operation of Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: MMC encounters serious limitations in the zero and low-frequency operation of variable-speed motor drives. In MMC, the voltage ripples of SubModule (SM) capacitor is inversely proportional to the phase current frequency. This paper proposes a new approach to solve the zero-/low- frequency operation technical issue of MMC-based drive systems. The proposed approach utilizes the additional degrees of freedom of multiphase machines to inject secondary-plane current components with certain magnitude and frequency in the load current to enable smooth operation during that interval. A simulation model of a three-level five- phase MMC-based Induction Machine (IM) drive system has been built using MATLAB/Simulink. In this paper, the adopted control strategy is explained and the simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Experimental Study and Functional Regime Analysis of an Electric Pump Unit With a Three-Phase Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article presents and analyses obtained experimental results for two basic functional regimes of an electric pump unit consisting of an external gear reversible motor/pump and a three phase asynchronous motor. The natural characteristics in the engine and generator mode of the asynchronous machine, as well as the pumping/motor regimes for the hydraulic machine have been simulated and examined at a specialized hydraulic rig. The basic quantitative ratios have been set out and important conclusions have been made in the established mode of operation of the pump unit.

articleTitle: Electrical coil thermal parameters determination by express experimental data processing
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Investigation results are presented for electrical coil thermal parameters prediction. The coil is EI transformer type construction. The time constant and steady state temperature rise are predicted, based only on limited number experimental data, using directly Least Square Method (LSM) and recommendations in [1]. The equivalent values for the coil heat capacity and thermal resistance are also calculated, which opens a way to investigate various transient processes by computer simulation. Comparative results for a separate coil and iron-cored one are presented, analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Study of Physical Model of WECS with Synchronous Generator and Back-to-back Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents the results from development and experimental study of a physical model of a direct driven wind energy conversion system (WECS) with synchronous generator (SG), connected to the grid via a back-to-back converter. The control is a combination of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm, maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) strategy with field oriented vector control (FOC) for the generator, and voltage oriented vector control (VOC) for the grid-side converter. The proposed power control scheme is applied on a test bench with DC motor, synchronous generator and electronic converters. The complete control software is implemented on dSpace DS1104 platform. The developed control system is validated by various experimental studies. The results show the good performance of the control under steady-state and variable wind speed conditions.

articleTitle: Comparision Between Clasical and Modern Methods for Optimal Control of Buck DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this research a comparison of control methods of a buck DC/DC converter realized with neural network NARMA and PI regulator are presented. The possibilities of this control method for function approximation are demonstrated. The paper presents a comparison between a classical and modern methods for smart control.

articleTitle: Sentinel-1 SAR SLC Image Ship Detection and Motion Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the paper "Sentinel - 1" SAR single look complex signal model of a moving point target is presented. An algorithm for complex SAR SLC images ship detection and its heading and speed estimation is proposed. Verification of the estimated SAR ship target parameters is done with data from Bulgarian AIS coastal system.

articleTitle: Modelling the Processes of Hydraulic Commutation in an Electro-Hydraulic Pumping Unit Driven by an Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A mathematical model is presented, describing the small dynamic changes in the operating parameters of the electro-hydraulic pumping unit around an average steady state value. These forced fluctuations are caused by the commutation processes, which equalize the pressure in the working chambers of displacement type hydraulic machine. A block diagram is derived and dynamic structure analysis is conducted. The time and frequency response of the dynamic model are examined numerically, based on experimental data.

articleTitle: Experimental Survey and Analysis on the Impact of the Commutation Process on a Positive Displacement Pump Driven by an Asynchronous Electric Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The results of a natural experiment carried out with a volumetric rotary hydraulic pump driven by a three-phase asynchronous electric motor are presented and analyzed in the present work. The basic pressure fluctuations of the "pump outlet" and their influence on the electrical parameters of the asynchronous machine were studied in quasi-set operating mode. The investigations were conducted with specialized equipment in real time and in the frequency domain. The connectivity and influence of the energy-exchange processes have been proved in both machines.

Author Keywords: hydraulic and electrical parameters of the operating regime

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Electronically Controlled Closed-Loop Electrohydraulic System with Variable Displacement Pump
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article presents the design of the hydraulic circuit diagram, synthesis of the main hydraulic parameters and equipment of experimental setup for studying of an electronically controlled closed-loop electrohydraulic system based on variable displacement axial-piston pump. The setup allows for experimental work with various pressure loads of different types of executive device: hydraulic cylinders or hydraulic motors. The equipment of the experimental system with an external control electronics provides the possibilities to carry out study not only by changing the hydraulic parameters, but also by changing of the parameters in the embedded control system.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Synthesis of Mismatched Filters for Processing of Aperiodic Phase Manipulated Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The phase manipulated (PM) signals, which autocorrelation functions (ACFs) have small side-lobes, are very important for the radars, sonars, radio-navigation and radio-synchronization systems. The experience, obtained during the past seventy years, shows that the problem of synthesis of aperiodic PM signals, which ACFs have small side-lobes, is extremely hard. A promising approach for solving of this problem is the usage of mismatched filters (MMFs). Accounting this fact in the paper a new algorithm for synthesis of MMFs for processing of aperiodic PM signals is suggested. The results, obtained in the paper, could be applied in the process of development of new radio-communication devices, used for precise measurement of distances.

Author Keywords: mismatched filters for processing of aperiodic phase manipulated signals

articleTitle: Implementation of collision sense and orientation system
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper is focused on the aspects of safety in the field of land and naval transportation systems. The main scope of the work is based on collision recognition in the transportation environment. The necessity of detection system is addressed by the design of collision detection algorithms and apparatus. The functionality of the hardware and software designed solutions is verified by the experimental results obtained by the hardware.

articleTitle: Ultracapacitor Charging From a Source with Varying and Limited Power
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article explores a system for ultracapacitor charging from a source with varying and limited power (in this case photovoltaic module). The system is based on the Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter (SEPIC) and constant-power and voltage-limiting regulator. A scheme for computer simulation with PSIM program is presented, as well as the simulation results under different conditions.

articleTitle: Innovation in the teaching methodology of electronics
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Using the software environment MULTISIM when teaching electronics to students enrolled in Electrical engineering and electronics module is an innovative approach which inspires more interest in the field and allows quicker understanding of the material. In this paper are given examples of combining real (laboratory) experiment with the effects of the virtual (computing) experiment for research, visualization and analysis of the work of some of the fundamental electronic circuits.

articleTitle: Some Aspects of Laser Cutting of Thick-Walled Workpieces of Phase-Shifting Steels
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This study presents the impact of laser electro-technological treatment on the microstructure of phase-shifting steels in thick-walled workpieces. In order to investigate the temperature field, leading to the phase shifts in the workpiece volume, the following methods were applied: metallographic analysis by light microscopy, Vickers hardness method and numerical modeling based on the finite element method by using Comsol Multyphysics. The results obtained are directly related to the process parameters of the laser treatment, which determines the possibility of adjusting and optimizing the laser cutting process.

articleTitle: Improving of the Combined Cycle Power Plant Operation Under Islanding Conditions Through Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Combined cycle power plants (CCPPs) are very popular nowadays due to high efficiency, however, they possess unique frequency response characteristics compared with traditional thermal power plants. Therefore, combined cycle gas turbine dynamics may influence system stability during large frequency excursions in power network. This is significantly important when considering CCPP islanding with high demand area, since in these conditions there is a high probability of frequency collapse. In order to avoid deep frequency reductions under islanding it can be applied voltage reductions as a way to decrease the load value at the first period of time. This study shows that this measure provides possibility to maintain system stability under islanding with power shortage.

articleTitle: Implementation of Embedded Three-Loop Control Algorithm for Electrohydraulic Power Steering System
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents the design, synthesis and implementation of a three-loop cascade control algorithm with a digital proportional integral regulator intended for installation in a modern electrohydraulic power steering systems for low speed vehicles. The developed control algorithm is embedded into a 32-bit microprocessor of a laboratory test rig. The structure of control system and the layout of the hydraulic system are shown. The cascade control algorithm consists of three regulators for output variables: proportional spool valve position, supplying flow rate and cylinder piston position. The parameters of PI regulator are tuned by model-based approach in Simulink environment and experimentally are refined. Evaluation with experiments have been carried out to present the performance of the electrohydraulic power steering system. The results from evaluation with experiments will serve as a basis for SIMO system identification for obtained a dynamical plant model and realization of advanced control strategies implementable in vehicles.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of HV Cables Electrical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The simulations of electromagnetic transients in power systems require accurate representation of the elements through their models. The increasing share of HV and EHV cables gives rise to a number of questions concerning their appropriate modelling for the particular tasks. This involves knowledge of the effect of cable design and material properties on cable electrical characteristics.

articleTitle: Near Region Acoustic Driver Circular Cone
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper contains analytical and graphical application of mathematical model proposed for calculations of sound pressure level (SPL) and frequency response in near region valid for circular cone shaped acoustic drivers. Comparison of analytical results with experimental measurement for real loudspeaker SPL and frequency response in near region was made. Conclusions with practical applicability have been made for air and water environments.

articleTitle: Power System Sectionalizing Optimization Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper proposes the algorithm for searching the optimal configuration of the power network, taking into account short-circuit currents and losses, using the genetic algorithm. The proposed method allows finding the optimal configuration of the power network effectively, for a relatively small number of iterations (significantly less than with a full search of all options). The influence of the population size on the number of runs to calculate the mode and short-circuit currents is analyzed. Standard IEEE schemes were used as test schemes, with 14 nodes, 20 branches and 118 nodes, 186 branches. The modeling was performed in the MATLAB software environment and the package of procedures for calculating the Matpower 6.0 mode.

articleTitle: Analysis of non-uniform magnetic flux distribution in conical rotor double-speed induction motors
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The variable geometric dimensions of the magnetic circuit in the conical rotor induction motors in axial direction makes the magnetic flux non-uniform distribution in the length of the magnetic core. An analytical multisectional method for electromagnetic calculation has been developed accounting the special features of the motor design. It allows obtaining correct values of the magnetic flux density distribution and preventing oversaturation in some parts of the motor core. Numerical results for the non-uniform distribution of the magnetic flux density in the air-gap, teeth zone and yokes in longitudinal direction have been presented for two analyzed motors.

articleTitle: Modified Low-Frequency Filter for Signal Spectrum Limitation at Analog-Digital Converter’s Input with Differential Input
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: We have considered a modified architecture of the third order low-frequency filter (LFF), intended to be applied as an anti-alias filter on inputs of analog-digital converters (ADC's) with differential input. We have obtained conditions for low-frequency filter's circuit parametrical synthesis. We have shown results of suggested LFF simulation and compared its amplitude-frequency characteristics (AFC's) at different frequencies of applied operational amplifiers' (OP-AMP's) unity gain (AD8132, THS4131).

articleTitle: Regression Analysis of Experimental Data for Electrical Parameters of Water at a High Voltage Pulse Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Many physical and chemical processes are observed in water under the formation of high voltage discharges, which depend on the characteristic of the system for generation of high voltage discharge pulses and the physical properties of the liquid medium. Considering the dynamics of these processes, the determination of the electrical parameters of the water is necessary for the practical usage of the electrical discharges in water in different technological applications. The aim of the present paper is to analyze experimental data for the water resistance change during the formation of a high-voltage discharge pulse regarding the influence of some electrical parameters of the system and the water temperature. A complex mathematical model based on a three-factor regression analysis of the experimental data for the change of the water resistance in the first half-period of a high voltage attenuating discharge pulse is proposed. A simplification of the proposed model is also suggested with good correlation (94,9 %) and a coefficient of determination 90,1 %.

articleTitle: Crankshaft position magnetoelectric sensor for controller area network bus
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper is connected to the research of crankshaft position magnetoelectric sensor with signal processing implementation for controller area network (CAN) applications. The signal processing and CAN bus give remarkable opportunity to integrate crankshaft position magnetoelectric sensor into modern automotive systems. The advantage of this design is the high sensitivity, the relatively low cost of the sensor and high reliability.

articleTitle: An Approach for Analysis of the Magnetic Field of Induction Motor with a Squirrel-Cage Rotor
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper considers an approach for modelling the electromagnetic field of an induction machine with a squirrel-cage rotor in the mode of ideal idle move. To implement the model, a program product COMSOL Multiphysics was used. The results obtained were confirmed by an experimental study of the machine by measuring the dispersion field around the machine body.

articleTitle: Signal processing at anodizing of Ti-6Al-7Nb alloy
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Anodizing is a widely used process for the passivation of titanium. The essence of the process is to build an oxide layer on the surface of a detail of titanium. The process is carried out by applying an electric field to an electrolytic cell via an external voltage source, which starts with reduction-oxidation (redox) reaction. The anodizing is used for treatment the surfaces of details of titanium alloys also. The studying of this treatment involves the processing of signals of a different nature that give information about the essence of the anodizing and discover details about the stages in forming of the titanium oxide layer. The paper presents theoretical statement of the process and the way of processing of the real measured signals at the anodizing of Ti-6Al-7Nb alloy.

articleTitle: Module for Taximeter Use of CAN Interface in Car
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The modern cars use information about the speed from the ABS system. This paper proposes a solution for taxicabs. The developed taximeter device uses the impulses from ABS for measurement of the distance of road and amount of money to be charged. This module reads current information about the speed using an internal CAN interface and generates a number of impulses proportional to the current vehicle speed. The device doesn't influence the work of the other electronic systems of the vehicle. It can be used in any modules produced after 2000. The device is cheap. It was approved in real road conditions and its accuracy is 1.5%.

articleTitle: Study of Piezoelectric Spring Harvesters
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a study of two piezoelectric spring harvesters conducted with the aim to determine the optimal construction for which better electrical characteristics are obtained. The harvesters under consideration consist of springs and concentrated masses, attached to piezoelectric transformers. Modeling by ANSYS has been performed, whereas the horizontal deviation of the mechanical system has been obtained and the charge, accumulated on the electrodes of the piezoelectric plates has been calculated. Experimental tests for validating the developed model have been carried out.

articleTitle: Uncertainty considerations of measuring equipment during experimental research in machining
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents certain considerations about lowering of the measuring uncertainty of the machining process empirical models in turning. It is considered that the lowering of the contributions from the computer aided measuring equipment and the use of appropriate research approaches can be the main factor of gaining reliable research results. The work is based on an empirical research that has been performed by using our own developed machining process modelling and research system.

articleTitle: A Method of Binary Compression
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This report presents an algorithm for compression of binary images transmitted in real time. The algorithm is suitable for images that need to be transmitted without loss and for a short time. The image is obtained by pre-processing a color image. We performed a comparative evaluation using a set of real-world images. The empirical analysis shows that a higher compression rate is achieved when compared to WinZIP.

articleTitle: Revisiting the Plotting of Mechanical Characteristic of Induction Motor with A Wound Rotor
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper method for determining the parameters of the equivalent circuit of an induction motor with a wound rotor based on the combined data of the no-load and motor operating conditions experiments was discusses. A scheme for measuring the necessary parameters to plotting the motor characteristics was described. A comparison of measured and calculated data was made.

Author Keywords: induction motor with a wound rotor
equivalent circuit of an asynchronous motor
experimental determination of the parameters of the equivalent circuit

articleTitle: Determination of Parameters of High-Frequency Matching Transformer of Installation of Induction Heating
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: To create a mathematical model of an induction heating complex, it is necessary to know the parameters of all the elements of the equivalent circuit, the most important are the parameters of the high-frequency matching transformer. The article describes a series of experiments to determine these parameters. The connection diagrams of measuring equipment and the results of research are given.

articleTitle: PID Control of Analog Three-Dimensional Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Multi-loop (decentralized) Proportional-Integral-Derivative controllers find extensive use in industrial systems. An auto-tune method is present in the paper. The independent design approach is used. The method treats the multivariable system as independent SISO systems with interactions as an additive uncertainty. Modified relay feedback is applied. A software is developed using Siemens TIA Portal V15. The approach is tested on a three-dimensional multivariable system, modelled by an analog board.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Production of Electrical Energy from Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The production of electricity from renewable energy sources (RES) increases every year. For Bulgaria, a serious relative share is that obtained from photovoltaics. Because of its volatile nature, however, it creates a number of problems. One of the most important is related to its forecasting. Although there are different forecasting methods, much is currently being done to increase their reliability and accuracy. This determines the high priority of the present research work.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The use of high-frequency transformers in combination with synchronous reversible rectifiers-inverters and microprocessor-based control systems allows you to manage the exchange of energy between objects of the electrical network while simultaneously stabilizing the voltage, which improves the quality and reliability of power supply to consumers, reduces losses during transmission, distribution and power consumption. The article discusses the construction of a control system for a multifunctional electronic transformer with reversible synchronous rectifiers-inverters and a high-frequency transformer.

articleTitle: Particularities Regarding Design of Asynchronous Motors used for Driving Coal Mills
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The motors used for driving coal mills in a steam power plant use a lot of active and reactive electrical energy, so they work with high exploitation costs. Reducing the exploitation costs is a very difficult problem, even if we use performant computers, because heavy working conditions (load shocks, high temperatures etc.) and restrictive requirements imposed by this drive must be taken into account. By using this information, it is possible to carry out an optimal design of asynchronous motors used in coal mills. The design uses mathematical models which take into account the magnetic saturation, as well as the current pressing effect, thus obtaining valuable results within a range of admissible and practical errors. The optimization is justified by reducing the exploitation cost of a motor with 34800 € as against the existing variant and by presenting the simulated operation characteristics of the motor obtained.

Author Keywords: asynchronous motors used for driving coal mills

articleTitle: Thermographic study of the heating of a pulse-controlled magnetic-technological device
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The results from a thermographic study of the heating of a permanent magnet technological device with pulse control are presented in the paper. An analysis, of the obtained thermographic images, has been made, and the values, of the temperature rise in the magnetic-technological device, have been determined. Also, the change of temperature along the length and width of the magnetic-technological device have been considered.

articleTitle: Real Time Monitoring of HV Electrical Machines Driving Powerful Pump Aggregates
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper summarizes our experience in building a system for real time monitoring of electrical parameters of powerful pump aggregates. The pumping station supplies cooling water for the main cycle of a power plant and is considered to be a part of the safety systems of the plant. The monitoring of the pump aggregates had to be realized not as an independent system but as a "patch" to the existing system for monitoring of the power supply of the station. The measurement capabilities of the existing devices are used. A set of issues with significant impact on practical realization of such a system are discussed here.

articleTitle: Simulation of the low-frequency electromagnetic transducer of the compensating source of the active vibration damping system
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper modelling of vibroacoustic transducers in the frequency range from 6 Hz to 10 Hz in a single software environment is considered. In the course of the study, a technique for modelling a low-frequency electromagnetic converter of an active vibration damping system (ADVS) compensating source was studied and successfully applied. For the simulation, modern tested software COMSOL Multiphysics was used, which uses the finite element method and allows solving problems from various fields. In particular, COMSOL Multiphysics had enough capabilities to perform this work, and all modeling took place in a single environment.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Operational Parameters of a Medium Voltage Cable Line
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: finite element analysis; power system simulation; induction motors; magnetic flux; optimisation; rotors; Matlab; power generation control; pumps; control system synthesis.

articleTitle: A novel method for determining the maximum energy flows, passed though the electrical power systems under interval uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Present paper is addressed to solve the maximum energy flow problem in electrical power systems under interval uncertainties. The solution is found by analysis of two main tasks, described by basic mathematical models of controlled electrical power systems: a single source - multiple recipients and multiple sources - multiple recipients. In the suggested method the graph theory is applied. The original models mentioned above transform to the basic graph model consists of a single source - a single recipient. A new interval method for obtaining the maximum energy flow in arbitrary system using interval channel capacities is suggested. The proposed procedures have simple realization and take a small volume of computation and time resources. Numerical example of electrical power system with single source and multiple recipients is solved. The paper finishes with conclusion remarks about application areas of the new method proposed for solving the maximum flow problem under interval uncertainties.

articleTitle: Band-Pass ARC-Filter with Pole Frequency, Pole Decay and Transfer Ratio Independent Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: We have discussed properties of band-pass ARC-filters' (ARCF) new circuit, in which it is possible to adjust the following basic parameters independently: pole frequency (ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>), pole decay (d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>) and transfer ratio in band-pass (M). We have obtained basic expressions, which allow synthesizing ARCF. We have presented adjustment algorithm and computer simulation results, which show that it is possible to adjust the parameters ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, M independently in the suggested ARCF circuit solution, for example, using digital potentiometers microcircuits.

articleTitle: Electrical Equipment Technical State Integral Estimate Based On Additional Non-Destructive Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the development of the methods for the integral estimate of the technical state of high-voltage electrical equipment based on additional methods of non-destructive testing such as thermal imaging and ultraviolet monitoring, the method of measuring partial discharges in insulation. The paper presents the methodology, hardware and technical solution and their testing on the 110 kV outdoor switchgear of an actual power station.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling and Experimental Verification of a Hybrid Electromagnetic System with Magnetic Flux Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Finite element analysis of a hybrid electromagnetic system with magnetic flux modulation is carried out. The main idea is to build computer model for studying the main parameters of devices of this type. To ensure reliability of achieved results from the computer model, an experimental prototype of the modelled device is built. Specially designed control and measurement circuits are assembled. The obtained results are compared and analysed.

articleTitle: A Model for Development of Professional Competence in Students of Technical Institutes of Higher Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Contemporary engineering education is based on the integrating role of individual expert which is why the present day fundamental goal of higher professional education is to achieve a rounded personality development and ensure continual enhancement of their professional competence (PC). The paper presents a theoretically formulated model for development and growth of PC in students of technical universities that is consistent with the goals and tasks of the process under research. It also presents a description of the model's components which are organized in five separate blocks: purpose, functional, contents, organizational, and diagnostic-assessment. The paper recommends examples for interdisciplinary integration for different subjects (between subjects from humanitarian sciences and technical sciences, interdisciplinary laboratory exercises by using ICT, seminary exercises in the subjects "Physics", "Mathematics" and special learning disciplines etc).

articleTitle: Servo System Parameter Estimation by Wavelet Method
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Wavelet functions are widely applied in engineering practice. In the present paper they are used for evaluation of the servo electrical drive parameters. The estimation accuracy is assessed. The results obtained are analysed, and conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Investigation Of The Pressure variation In The Chambers Of External Gear Pumps With Symmetric And Asymmetric Tooth Profiles Used In Electrohydraulic Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper the results of the numerical determination of the pressure variation of the working fluid for external gear pumps with symmetric and asymmetric tooth profiles have been given. It is shown that for pumps with asymmetric teeth profiles, the pressure variation is more uniform as with symmetric teeth profiles. Regardless of the shape of the teeth, the greatest pressure drop is the pressure on the first teeth spaces in relation to the intake chamber, due to the difference in radial clearance for the different teeth as a result of the eccentric arrangement of the gear relative to the pump case.

articleTitle: Parametrized Modelling of a Hybrid Electromagnetic System with Magnetic Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Parametrized model of a hybrid electromagnetic system featuring modulation of the magnetic flux has been developed using the finite element method and COMSOL software. The model gives opportunity to study the influence of different geometric and physical parameters on the performance of the system. The system consists of a core, permanent magnet and three coils - one input and two output coils. The input coil is supplied by a pulse voltage source. Active loads are connected to the output coils. The problem has been solved as a coupled problem electromagnetic field - electric circuit one. Results have been obtained for the distribution of the magnetic field and the power of the output coils when varying three geometric parameters. The developed model can serve as a basis for further optimization of the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of a Wind Turbine based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Advanced controllers of modern wind turbines can help increase energy capture efficiency and reduce structural loading. However, to fulfill the modern wind turbine control demands with contradicting requirements (efficiency and reliability), innovative control methods that can handle multi-objective problems are inevitable. In this paper, we propose adaptive control techniques, which trying to extract the stochastic property of wind speed using a trained reinforcement learning (RL) agent and then apply their obtained optimal policy to the wind turbine adaptive control design. This paper includes the results of tests of the developed torque controller and a multi-input-multi-output (MIMO)-based controller using advanced RL algorithms.

articleTitle: Assessment of Conditions for the Applications of DLT for Smart Metering in Bulgaria According to the European Requirements
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The implementation of smart metering is part of the EU strategy to increase the transparency and accuracy of the data transmitted to the utility sector in the Member States, as well as to increase the energy efficiency of the electricity distribution companies. The factors hampering the introduction of smart meters based on the existing regulatory framework in Bulgaria lagging behind from EU regulatory initiatives have been studied. We have analyzed the benefits of using a DLT solution in the exchange of information among system participants: users; facilities; utility companies and regulators. The action diagram of a DLT solution based on CORDA for the Utilities sector is visualized.

articleTitle: The Development of a Joint Modelling Framework for Operational Flexibility in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The TU Dortmund University (Germany) and the Energy Systems Institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences (Russia) launched a joint research project to develop a unified modelling approach for distributed flexibility options. While recent approaches for distributed flexibility fail at common understanding of flexibility in the different layers of the power system, the participants will develop a modelling framework that allows the detailed quantification of flexibility potentials with a distribution-oriented perspective as well as on a systemwide view.

articleTitle: Active Battery Balancing Via a Switched DC/DC Converter: Description and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a new converter-based active balancing topology. This equalizer topology consists of a single non-isolated DC/DC converter and cell-to-cell power routing via controlled switches, which are operated as power multiplexers. The design and control strategy of the equalizer are explained. Its performance is assessed in simulation. The equalizer balances an imbalanced battery pack of five monobloc batteries, compensating the initial SOC deviations and keeping the pack balanced from then on. The influence of four battery parameters in SOC divergence is analyzed.

articleTitle: Impedance Matching for an Inductive Harvesting Transducer
publicationTitle: 2019 16th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents an inductive transducer coupled to an articulated device for harvesting applications. This device, taking advantage of the sway of the waves of the sea, produces a linear oscillating motion in a solenoid-magnet. Using some magnetic fundamentals, a model of the transducer is deduced. This model is then extended to a harvesting device made with three transducers. Different transducer prototypes, with different number of coil turns, wire gauge, and magnets, have been developed to optimize it. The energy harvested form the final transducer array is processed electronically to charge an autonomous system battery. To maximize the energy collected the principle of impedance matching is used. Thus, the output impedance of the transducer array must match the converter input impedance. A buck-boost hybrid converter (HBB) controlled to behave as a Loss Free Resistor is proposed as impedance adaptor circuit. After the theoretical analysis, several simulation and experimental results are given.
